title: Vocabulary pack, format_version 1
description:
Exchange format produced by Claude (see docs/claude-project-instructions.txt) and imported by the vocabulary training app. The app's importer (crate vocab-pack) is the authoritative validator; this schema states the same contract. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express, and how errors are scoped (pack / word / sentence), are listed in docs/design/architecture.md, section 'Import'. A pack valid against this schema is accepted in full by the importer, except for the few rules a schema cannot express (a headword repeated within one pack, control characters in text, a Czech translation without any letter, part.index greater than part.total, an exported_at that is not a real calendar date; see architecture.md section 5.2). The importer is deliberately more lenient in one respect only: unknown properties are reported as warnings and ignored instead of rejecting the word. For every optional property null means 'not given'. Line breaks may be written as 
, 
 or ; the importer stores 
.

format_version.description: Version of the format itself. The app rejects versions it does not know.

pack_id.description: <source.id>--<YYYY-MM-DD>--<n>. Idempotency key together with the pack's content hash. The importer warns (does not reject) when the prefix differs from source.id.

exported_at.description: Export date (YYYY-MM-DD), a real calendar date. Used to decide which pack's reading_position is the newest; without it the day of the import is used.

part.description: Position of this pack in a multi-pack export. Defaults to 1 of 1 when omitted.

reading_position.description: Books only: how far the owner has read when the pack was exported (e.g. 'Chapter 14').

optionalText.description: Optional free text. null and blank text are treated as absent.

visibleText.description: Text with at least one visible character: not only whitespace and invisible characters (zero-width space/joiners, word joiner, byte order mark, soft hyphen).

id.description: Stable, lowercase-hyphenated id; the same book/film/article always has the same id. 'general' for general vocabulary.

title.description: Title of the book/film/article; for general vocabulary "General Vocabulary". Optional (null = not given): an existing source keeps its title; a new source without one is named "General Vocabulary" (type general) or after its id, with a warning, until a later pack brings a title.

url.description: Web address of an article: http:// or https:// only.

markedText.description: Text with EXACTLY ONE target span marked as [[...]]. The span is non-empty, does not start or end with whitespace and does not start with ']'. No other '[[' or ']]' may appear (no nesting, no second span). The pattern needs ECMA-262 lookahead/lookbehind; the importer implements the same rule with a hand-written scanner (first '[[', then the first ']]' after it, then no further '[[' or ']]' in the text).

en.description: English sentence; the target word marked in the form it appears, e.g. 'Boots [[thudded]] down the corridor.'

cs.description: Natural Czech translation of the whole sentence; the Czech words translating the target marked.

origin.description: book = quoted verbatim from the book; source = quoted from an article/film; example = written by Claude.

location.description: Chapter or page for quoted sentences; omitted for examples. A bare page number may be a JSON number; it is stored as text.

shortList.description: A list of short texts; null is treated as absent.

headword.description: Base form; may be a phrase ('pore over', 'carpet-bomb'). Identity key for merging (after normalisation: Unicode NFC, trimmed, inner whitespace collapsed, lowercased).

forms.description: Forms in THIS meaning; [] (or null) if not relevant.

speak.description: Text for text-to-speech; defaults to the headword.

czech.description: Czech equivalents, most common first, one per item.

goal.description: Default when omitted: active for usefulness >= 6, otherwise recognise (R-15).

accepted.description: English answers accepted in the Produce card (exact match after mechanical normalisation).

confusables.description: English words the owner might mix this word up with.

hint.description: Short memory hook shown for problem words (instructions ask for ~120 characters).

spelling.description: Worth a separate Spelling card (R-58). Default false.

tag.description: Leave it out (or null) when the word has no tag for this source; on a re-export that keeps the tag the app already has.

icon.description: One emoji or a Lucide icon name.

seq.description: Optional order of the word within its source (P-1), e.g. the seq of a converted old vocabulary page. Used only when the word is first linked to the source; later packs never change an existing word's order. Without it the word goes after the source's highest seq (order of import and of the words array).

sentences.description: Practice sentences (target 3-5); null = none. Fewer than 3 visible sentences means the Understand card uses the word-only format (it switches to the sentence format once the word has 3).
